headline: Stlican Shelf Stirs as Weathered Expanse Quiets
war_summary: Since the midday edition the wire has shifted, with Stlican Shelf returning to action with three changes in the last two hours to the filing minute and thirty-one on the day about Thornhold and The Pale House, standing six Warden to three Colonial with day losses near 4,176 Colonial and 5,858 Warden and both rates accelerating. Weathered Expanse has eased to two changes in the last two hours after thirteen in six and thirty-seven on the day about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now four Warden to five Colonial with day losses about 12,927 Colonial and 17,245 Warden still quickening. Fisherman's Row remains the day's busiest with thirty-eight changes centered on Black Well and Fort Ember but none in the last two hours, holding one Warden to eight Colonial, while Linn Mercy, Mooring County, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the last two hours despite nine to eighteen changes on the day. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line report no flips despite severe day tolls exceeding eleven thousand Colonial in the former and accelerating losses in both.
